_comment.connection_uri: Transport endpoint. Examples: 'tcp:127.0.0.1:5760' (local SITL), 'tcp:192.168.1.50:5760' (SITL on a remote host), 'serial:///dev/ttyACM0:115200' (real Pixhawk over USB), 'udpin:0.0.0.0:14550' (SITL --out forwarder).
_comment.source_system: MAVLink source-system ID for this client. 255 = GCS-class, matches MAVProxy's default. The autopilot is sysid 1.
_comment.heartbeat_timeout: Seconds to wait for first heartbeat on connect.
_comment.default_takeoff_alt_m: Default altitude for Vehicle.takeoff() if no argument given.
